name: @stillmvd/tauri-ship
description: One way to release and update Tauri 2 apps on Windows: local signed build, background GitHub publish, in-app toast

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --test cli/lib.test.mjs && cargo clippy --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml
